title: Ned Fills a Sack
note: b414 — Phase 4 (Learning) — consonant clusters pr, sc, sk.

pages.brief: Ned the duckling standing at the sandy edge of a stream.
Ned spotting several small shiny bits scattered on the sandy ground.
Ned the duckling picking up one small shiny bit in his bill.
Ned the duckling with six small shiny bits gathered in front of him.
Ned the duckling dropping the shiny bits into a small cloth sack.
Ned the duckling continuing to pick up more shiny bits along the sandy ground.
The cloth sack now bulging, full of shiny bits.
Ned the duckling carrying the bulging sack back toward his den.
Ned the duckling beside his den, the sack of shiny bits sitting next to it.
